known.header-page/path-and-action: Fails at 320 only (1440, 1280 and 390 hold): a heading too long for its row beside the kept actions cannot be known before the code. At 320 «Каталог решений» with its star, ⋯ and «Создать» do not fit one line, so the folded row takes a line of its own under the heading when the code lays it (printed 116 -> 108). Whether they fit is the words' widths against the line, not a step of any width, and the host cannot query its own width before its code (ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-15-header-bare-tag, residual case; dispatcher decision for the GB7 refresh).
